correctness.rationale: Direct proof: \(A-A=\{0,\pm1,\pm3,\pm4\}\), subfactors are maximal independent sets; no admissible gap is 1,3,4 or \(\ge10\), neighboring 2-gaps are forbidden, 7–9 gaps require 2 on either side, and these conditions suffice by checking all interior vertices and forbidden pair separations. Complete small-order logic and the insertion of a 5-gap in each of ten base words yield the exact all-order stability classification. Rooted gap-word double counting gives \(N_{n,k}=nW_{n,k}/k\). Independently exhaustive graph and cyclic-word enumerators agreed for \(5\le n\le18\), plus 300 tested constructive instances; tests corroborate but do not prove the symbolic all-n result.

value.rationale: The 2026 paper explicitly motivates index stability for normalized three-element subsets; {0,1,4} is the first choice beyond t=2,3 whose distinct positive difference steps are not a consecutive interval. The theorem gives the entire class of maximal subfactors for every cyclic order, exact cardinality-enumeration via cyclic gap words, and a sharp all-order index-stability classification with the nonmonotone order-13 exception. This structural result is more than a finite or routine exercise and provides a concrete base for the outstanding general three-element project.
